description: Header file defining the QrSegment class for QR code data segmentation, including nested Mode class, static factory methods, and related constants.

classes.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, including mode, character count, and data bits.

classes.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::Mode
classes.description: Encapsulates the mode of a QR code segment, providing mode indicator bits and character count size based on version.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::makeSegments
methods.description: Generates a list of segments to encode a given text, optimizing mode switches.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::makeEci
methods.description: Creates a segment for Extended Channel Interpretation with a specified assignment value.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: Qrcodegen::QrSegment::isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in numeric mode.
